description: This file implements an Active Record pattern for database interaction, including classes for database connections, table schemas, and record operations such as load, insert, update, delete, and relationship management. It extends the base ADOdb library to support advanced features like JOIN, WORK, and LAZY modes, providing ORM-like capabilities for PHP applications.

classes.name: ADODB_Active_DB
classes.description: Represents an active database connection with associated tables and manages multiple database adapters.

classes.name: ADODB_Active_Table
classes.description: Represents table metadata including columns, keys, and relations, with methods to update column count.

classes.name: ADODB_Active_Record
classes.description: Extends database records with ORM capabilities, including relationships, CRUD operations, and metadata management.

methods.name: updateColsCount
methods.description: Updates the total column count including relations for the table.

methods.name: ADODB_SetDatabaseAdapter
methods.description: Associates a database object with an internal index, managing multiple database connections.

methods.name: UseDefaultValues
methods.description: Static method to get or set whether default table values are used when creating new records.

methods.name: SetDatabaseAdapter
methods.description: Static method for setting the database adapter for the Active Record class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an Active Record instance with optional table name, primary keys, database connection, and options.

methods.name: LoadRelations
methods.description: Loads related records based on defined relations, supporting lazy or join loading.

methods.name: UpdateActiveTable
methods.description: Refreshes the cached metadata for the associated table, including columns and keys.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Handles errors, optionally throwing exceptions or logging errors.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns the last error message encountered.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Returns the last error number.

methods.name: DB
methods.description: Returns the active database connection object.

methods.name: TableInfo
methods.description: Retrieves table metadata object for the current record.

methods.name: Reload
methods.description: Reloads the record from the database based on current primary key values.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Assigns values from a database row array to the record's properties, handling nested relations.

methods.name: LastInsertID
methods.description: Retrieves the last inserted ID from the database for auto-increment keys.

methods.name: doQuote
methods.description: Quotes a value appropriately for inclusion in SQL based on type.

methods.name: GenWhere
methods.description: Generates a WHERE clause based on primary key values.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads a record from the database based on conditions, including relations.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Inserts or updates the record in the database.

methods.name: Dirty
methods.description: Marks the record as modified so it will be saved.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts a new record into the database.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the record from the database.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Finds records based on WHERE condition, returning an array of record objects.

methods.name: packageFind
methods.description: Internal method to find and return active record objects; preserves PHP4 compatibility.

methods.name: Replace
methods.description: Replaces or inserts a record in the database using given primary keys.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the current record in the database if modified.

methods.name: GetAttributeNames
methods.description: Returns a list of attribute (column) names.
